frequency. The 10 MHz reference is a ``reference_clock``: its fractional error ε scales the
oscillator, so a true f displays at f / (1 + ε), and the ``:ROSCillator`` status says whether
the external reference is in use. Switching to EXTernal without a usable 10 MHz sine keeps the
internal oscillator and reports -221. Its SSB phase noise (``phase_noise``) rides the display
as noise around every line the mixer converts (the trace); without the table there is
none.

specan_mixer.label: 混频器
specan_mixer.about: 把输入与本振混频变到中频，含变频损耗和镜像抑制。
specan_mixer.about_en: Converts the input to the IF against the LO, with conversion loss and image rejection.
specan_mixer.doc:
The mixer: ``out`` is the input converted to the IF against the local
oscillator, f_if = f_rf − f_lo, less the conversion loss. What lies below the oscillator (the
image side) is rejected by ``image_rejection`` — completely without it, as before; the
oscillator's leak (``lo_feedthrough``) sits at DC in the IF frame; the declared ``spurs``
(m·f_rf ± n·f_lo responses) and the distortion products of the mixer's own intercepts appear
as further lines; the ``residuals`` are there with no input at all. The output depends on
where the oscillator is tuned.

``noise_figure`` is the whole receiver's (the earlier way to declare it): with no other stage
declaring one, the chain's cascaded figure is exactly this.

specan_rbw.label: RBW 滤波 / FFT
specan_rbw.about: 分辨率带宽：自动或手动，以及对应的高斯滤波（FFT 实现）。
specan_rbw.about_en: The resolution bandwidth, auto or manual, and its Gaussian filter as an FFT.
specan_rbw.doc:
The resolution filter: the resolution bandwidth — auto: span /
``auto_ratio``, snapped to the model's filter steps and held at or below ``auto_max``; manual
otherwise — and the Gaussian filter of that bandwidth at -3 dB, as a windowed FFT.

``in`` takes complex baseband samples, ``out`` gives the complex amplitude at each frequency
point of one transform (``bins``: the frame's ``center_hz`` is the tuned frequency its middle
point stands for, ``df_hz`` the spacing). A request for ``count`` points ``dt_s`` apart in
time reads the :func:`window_length` samples the window spans and pads the transform to
``count``; a steady tone reads its amplitude. The window is cut ``WINDOW_SIGMAS`` standard
deviations each side, so its response is the Gaussian down to about -70 dB.

The window gives both evaluations their filter: :meth:`response` is its
frequency response per detector, in closed form, for the analytic trace; :meth:`frames` uses
its coefficients. Its noise bandwidth is 1.0645 × RBW either way.

The rate it asks of the down-converter follows the RBW: one transform is to cover
``fft_width`` resolution bandwidths (the usable middle half of twice that rate). The steps
and limits are the model's: the 1-3-10 ladder to 3 MHz by default, the X-Series "10%"
steps to 8 MHz.

specan_trace.label: 迹线
specan_trace.about: 频谱仪的迹线与扫描：分析窗口、扫描时间、迹线模式和标记。
specan_trace.about_en: The analyzer's trace and scan: window, sweep timing, trace modes and markers.
specan_trace.doc:
The trace and scan engine: the analysis window and its settings couplings, the
sweep timing in virtual time, the RF history, the trace modes (write / average / max / min hold), the
markers, and the SCPI operations of the display. It reads the analog front end by its wiring:
from the IF filter upstream to the input, the lines at the head of that chain and the stages'
cascaded noise figure (evaluated analytically).

specan_vbw.label: 视频滤波
specan_vbw.about: 视频带宽：自动跟随 RBW，手动时影响扫描时间。
specan_vbw.about_en: The video bandwidth: auto follows the RBW; a manual value stretches the sweep.
specan_vbw.doc:
The video filter's bandwidth: auto follows the RBW; the manual value stretches the
sweep the same way the old monolith did (its auto sweep time uses min(RBW, VBW)). Steps and
limits as the resolution filter's; a ``vbw_max`` above the ladder is the wide-open setting.

status_register.label: 状态寄存器
status_register.about: 状态寄存器组：具名的条件/事件位、使能掩码和汇总位。
status_register.about_en: A status register group: named condition/event bits, an enable mask and a summary bit.
status_register.doc: A status register group: named condition/event bits, an enable mask, a summary bit.

supply_protection.label: 电源保护
supply_protection.about: 电源通道的过压/过流保护锁存。
supply_protection.doc:
A channel's OVP / OCP latch.

Crossing a threshold (0 disables it) latches the fault and turns the output off; enabling the
output while the fault stands is refused with the E36300's own error 729. ``clear`` (the
model's ``OUTP:PROT:CLE``) removes the latch and restores the output state that existed before
the fault, as the manual describes. The latch, the threshold judging and the trip/kind/clear
replies are the shared protection primitive (:class:`ProtectionLatch`); this block's
increments are the OCP delay in constant current and the output-state restore.

supply_readback.label: 电源回读
supply_readback.about: 电源通道的电压/电流/功率回读和稳压状态（CV/CC/OFF）。
supply_readback.about_en: A supply channel's V/I/P readback and regulation state (CV/CC/OFF).
supply_readback.doc:
A channel's V/I/P readback: the voltmeter and ammeter of the output, with the
regulation state (CV / CC / OFF) the front panel shows.

supply_tracking.label: 输出跟踪
supply_tracking.about: 输出 2 和 3 的组合：跟踪、并联或串联。
supply_tracking.about_en: The combination of outputs 2 and 3: track, parallel or series.
supply_tracking.doc:
The combination of outputs 2 and 3: track, parallel or series.

``mode`` is the instrument's combination state (OFF / TRAC / PAR / SER). Enabling a combination
requires both outputs off (the manual's constraint). ``topology`` says how the model combines:

- ``split`` (E36311A, ±25 V): output 3 is the negative supply. A change of either programmed
  voltage is mirrored to the other — track keeps ``CH3 = −|CH2|``, parallel ``CH3 = CH2`` and
  series ``CH3 = −CH2``; the physical connection is the bench wiring.
- ``internal`` (E36312A / E36313A, two +25 V outputs, user's guide "Specifying the Operation
  Mode" and "Using the Tracking Operation"): track sets output 3 to the same voltage as
  output 2 and vice versa; series and parallel are made inside the instrument — output 2
  delivers the combination (twice the voltage, or twice the current) and output 3 no longer
  operates, so programming it is refused with error 720 (the manual's "CH3 is not allowed
  when serial/parallel/track is enabled"; tracking keeps output 3 programmable, the guide's
  "and vice versa"). Output 2's range follows (its voltage/current settings' limits and the
  ``v_max``/``i_max``/``p_max`` of its stage); leaving the combination brings the
  independent range back and clips a level above it.

supply_transient.label: 输出瞬变
supply_transient.about: 电源通道在触发时从即时电平跳到触发电平。
supply_transient.about_en: A supply channel's step from the immediate to the triggered levels on a trigger.
supply_transient.doc:
A channel's output transient system: the step from the immediate to the triggered
levels on a trigger (N6700 "Programming Output Transients", E36300 INITiate/TRIGger).

The arm → ready → fire → abort machine is the ``Triggerable`` primitive's: the ready
delay, the trigger delay in virtual time and the ignored-trigger error are the
primitive's; what a trigger *does* here is the step this system writes.

``INITiate:TRANsient`` arms it (``initiate``); a trigger then writes ``v_triggered`` into the
``voltage`` setting when ``v_mode`` is STEP, and ``i_triggered`` into ``current`` when
``i_mode`` is STEP (FIXed leaves the level as it is). The trigger is ``TRIGger:TRANsient``
(``trigger``, any source), ``*TRG`` while the source is BUS (``bus_trigger``), or the arming
itself with the IMMediate source. ``ABORt:TRANsient`` (``abort``) disarms it. While initiated
the channel reports TRAN-active, while ready for a trigger WTG-tran (the N6700 operation
register's bits 6 and 4).

system.label: 系统命令
system.about: *CLS、预置和型号自己的错误队列命令。
system.about_en: *CLS, a preset and the error queue under the model's own headers.
system.doc:
``*CLS`` with a reply to its query form, a preset that is ``*RST`` under another header, and
the error queue under the model's own headers: ``next_error`` and
``error_count`` let a definition declare an error query that is not ``:SYSTem:ERRor?`` (Fluke's
``ERR?``), with the reply format given by the command's ``reply`` template (``{code},{text}``).

trigger_model.label: 触发模型
trigger_model.about: 测量仪表的 INITiate、触发和 FETCh?：按触发次数×采样次数读数。
trigger_model.about_en: A meter's INITiate, triggers and FETCh?: trigger count × sample count readings.
trigger_model.doc:
INITiate, triggers and FETCh? of a meter: ``trigger_count`` × ``sample_count`` readings of the
``sampler`` component, kept in ``buffer`` when one is named.

The arm → ready → fire → abort machine is the ``Triggerable`` primitive's; what a trigger
*does* here is the run: its readings (each batch after the trigger delay the primitive
consumed), kept for FETCh? and in the reading buffer.

tunable_laser.label: 可调激光源
tunable_laser.about: 功率和波长可设的连续光源，带快门和波长扫描。
tunable_laser.about_en: Continuous-wave light of settable power and wavelength, with a shutter and a sweep.
tunable_laser.doc:
A tunable laser source: continuous-wave light of settable power at a settable
wavelength, a shutter, and a wavelength sweep that runs in virtual time.

The sweep goes from ``sweep_start`` to ``sweep_stop`` (downwards when stop < start), either
continuously at ``sweep_speed`` or in steps of ``sweep_step`` held ``sweep_dwell`` each, for
``sweep_cycles`` cycles with ``sweep_delay`` between them (the laser sits at the start
wavelength during the delay). ``start`` begins it at the command's instant; the wavelength at
any instant follows from the settings and that instant, so a power meter logging during the
sweep sees the wavelength move. Outside a sweep the laser emits at ``wavelength`` — after one
ends too, unless ``park`` keeps it at the sweep's start or stop. Settings changed during a
sweep apply to the whole sweep from then on (the model keeps no history of them).

``wavelength_offset`` is the absolute wavelength error (emitted − set). Not modelled: mode
hops, linewidth and coherence control, power flatness over the sweep, the power settling after
a change, modulation, the trigger output (a logger starts by its own command).

unity_buffer.label: 单位增益缓冲器
unity_buffer.about: 单位增益缓冲：高阻输入、低阻输出。
unity_buffer.about_en: Unity-gain buffer: high-impedance input, low-impedance output.
unity_buffer.doc: Unity-gain buffer: high-impedance input, low-impedance output.

variable_optical_attenuator.label: 可调光衰减器
variable_optical_attenuator.about: 插入损耗加可设衰减的光衰减器，带快门和输出功率模式。
variable_optical_attenuator.about_en: Insertion loss plus a settable attenuation, with a shutter and an output-power mode.
variable_optical_attenuator.doc:
A variable optical attenuator: light from ``IN`` to ``OUT`` with the insertion
loss plus a settable attenuation, a shutter, and an optional output-power mode.

``spectral_loss`` is the extra loss against wavelength ([[m, dB], ...]); the attenuator is
calibrated at its set ``wavelength``, so only the difference between the arriving and the set
wavelength's loss shows. A change of attenuation reaches the output ``settling_time`` after
it (a step, the old value until then). In ``POWer`` mode the attenuation follows the light in
so that ``power_target`` leaves the output (an internal monitor tap), held within 0 …
``attenuation_max``; a target it cannot reach sets UNREACH. Not modelled: return loss,
polarization-dependent loss, the settling inside power mode.

waveform_synth.label: 波形合成
waveform_synth.about: 生成零点对称的 1 Vpp 标准波形，改频率时相位连续。
waveform_synth.about_en: A standard 1 Vpp waveform around zero, phase-continuous across frequency changes.
waveform_synth.doc:
A standard waveform at 1 Vpp around zero, phase-continuous across frequency changes.

``function``: SINusoid, SQUare (with ``duty``: a pulse when it is not 50 %), RAMP (``symmetry`` %
rising; 50 is a triangle), DC (zero: the level module adds the offset), ARBitrary and PRBS (the
``arb`` table or ``prbs`` source on the same channel). ``duty`` is a percentage or
a ratio as ``duty_unit`` declares; nothing is guessed from its size (0.1 is 0.1 % or 10 %, by the
declaration). Square, pulse and ramp keep harmonics up to ``bandwidth`` (and the line limit, with a
fidelity note); ``rolloff`` says how they end there: ``brickwall`` (all at full weight up
to the bandwidth: the edges ring, Gibbs) or ``gaussian`` (-3 dB at the bandwidth: no overshoot,
a 10–90 % edge of about 0.34 / bandwidth). ``clock`` names a reference_clock whose error scales
the frequency.

waveform_transfer.label: 波形传输
waveform_transfer.about: 把通道记录的选定点编码成文本、ASCII 列表或二进制块。
waveform_transfer.about_en: Encodes the selected points of a channel's record as text, ASCII or a binary block.
waveform_transfer.doc:
The selected points of a channel's record, encoded as text, an ASCII list or a binary
block. The source may name a math function (``FUNCtion<F>``): the record then comes
from the ``math`` block instead of the acquisition, with the same encoding and preamble.
